request_text_excerpt: PUBLIC RECORDS ACT REQUEST – STRUCTURAL DEFICIT / LABOR COST CONTAINMENT RECORDS. Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, Gov. Code § 7920 et seq., I request copies of the following records created, received, transmitted, or maintained between January 1, 2025 and the date this request is processed. … This request concerns the City's public representations about structural deficit solutions and whether labor cost containment options have been evaluated in addition to tax increases and service reductions. …
notes: Added by pull request: the watcher cannot see unpublished requests. As of 2026-09-30 the request is open and unpublished; 61 documents were released to the requester in three batches (June 12, August 14 and September 18, 2026), some marked Public and some Requester-only, including the employee budget-feedback survey. Per the published-only rule, nothing is archived until the City publishes the request; the public copies are then ingested.
